concerns.text: Foundational tasks (T003‑T010) are marked as completed ([X]) but they produce essential artifacts (e.g., `config.py`, `state.yaml`, prompt manifests, model loading code) that are later consumed by user‑story phases. Because they are already marked completed, the plan implies they have been executed before Phase 0 (Spec & Plan Alignment). This violates the FR‑010 rule that foundational tasks must precede any task that consumes their outputs. The ordering should be: Phase 0 → Phase 1 → Phase 2 (foundational) → user‑story phases.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 3 – User Story 1 – Generate & Analyse Code Snippets
concerns.text: Task T014 (Generation Loop) is a consumer of the merged prompt manifest created in T010, but T010 is only *implemented* (marked [X]) without an explicit dependency link. The plan does not enforce that T010 must finish before T014 starts, creating a potential race condition. Add an ordering constraint or make T014 depend on T010.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 3 – User Story 1 – Generate & Analyse Code Snippets
concerns.text: Task T016b (CWE Extraction) is required by FR‑004 to produce a `cwe_id` column, yet no preceding task generates the necessary parsed CWE data. The pipeline will fail because `raw_findings.csv` will lack this column. Insert a producer task (e.g., “Parse CWE IDs”) before T016b, or merge its logic into T015.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 4 – User Story 2 – Metrics, Calibration & Statistical Inference
concerns.text: Calibration template (T022a) and human‑labeling step (T022b) are prerequisites for any FPR‑correction (T022c) and downstream metric calculations (T023, T023b). However, the plan lists T022c as dependent on T022b but does not enforce that T022a must complete first, nor does it ensure that the manual labeling (T022b) is finished before any metric task runs. Explicit ordering is needed: T022a → T022b → T022c → T023/T023b.

Task T034 (Run Summary) is required to satisfy SC‑005 (completion‑rate ≥ 90 %). Yet no prior task guarantees that the completion‑rate metric has been computed; the only place it could be derived is in T034 itself. This creates a circular dependency. Introduce a preceding task that computes the completion‑rate (e.g., “Compute run‑summary metrics”) and have T034 simply format the results.

The `[P]` tag denotes parallel‑safe tasks. Several tasks marked `[P]` actually share mutable state without explicit isolation (e.g., T008a/b both write to `data/runtime_log.json` and `data/failures.log`). This violates the parallel‑safety guarantee. Either remove the `[P]` tag or refactor the tasks to write to distinct files or use thread‑safe mechanisms.

User‑story grouping requires each story to be independently shippable. US1 (T011‑T017) produces `snippets.csv` and `raw_findings.csv`, but US2 (T022a‑T029) also depends on those artifacts *and* on manual calibration data that is not part of US1. Because US2 cannot be executed without external manual input, the story is not fully independent. Either treat the calibration as a separate prerequisite story or clearly delineate the manual step as a gating artifact.

Task T038 (Optimise model loading/unloading order) changes the runtime behaviour of the generation pipeline, which directly impacts the time‑budget enforcement in T008b (Orchestrator). The plan does not specify that T038 must run *before* any generation tasks (T014) to ensure the orchestrator sees the optimized schedule. Add an ordering constraint: T038 → T014.

Task T041 (quickstart.md validation script) validates the documentation against the actual pipeline. It must run after all documentation‑related tasks (T036a‑T036c) and after the final state update (T035). The current ordering places it after T037c but before T035, which could cause false validation failures. Reorder to run after T035.
